speaker: Enzo Maresca
quote_text:
OK, who wants to get us underway? Andy. Hi,  Andrew. That must have proven a very frustrating  
end to the afternoon for you. And what does  it tell you about your Chelsea team and where  
they are at the moment? Oh yeah, as I said, I just  said that probably we did enough to win the game  
today. We between first half and second-half, I  think we create chances enough to win the game,  
but. In football you need to be clinical,  otherwise the game is always open, especially  
in this in this stadium, you know any transition,  any corner boosts the energy for them. But yeah,  
unfortunately at the end we concede, but overall,  I think today we did enough to to win the game.  
So what does that tell you about? I mean,  it's now four games to one and it's quite  
a frustrating spell for you and Newcastle have  gained the ground on you again. Today. So what's  
the mentality? No, it's two weeks ago, three weeks  ago, we were talking about title race. Now I never  
thought that we knew that Newcastle, Aston Villa  will be there. The city will be for sure there. So  
it's for me, it's not about the table, it's just  about to see how we can improve things. Today,  
the performance for me was was very good on the  ball of the ball. But this moment of the season,  
I I knew that it's going to happen in any season  for any team that you have some moment that you  
are not able to win games. The reason why I think  every game is different, sometimes it's for one  
reason, sometimes it's for different reason.  But today if I have to decide the reason why  
we didn't win the game, I think it's just. try to  be clinical when you have the chance to kill the  
game, because 2-0 probably the game is finished,  but if you continue to be you know open, open,  
open at the end, you are going to concede some  transition, some corner and you can concede.  
Against Everton and Fulham, you made, I think, two  subs and one sub, and then today you made two. It  
felt like earlier in the season you were making  a lot more, is there any reason behind this? No,  
I said because. . . Now we change. I ask you,  which player was to change today? I mean, you  
have Felix on the patch. Yeah, but for who? Yeah,  no, no but no, no it just, I know that is my job,  
but sometimes when we do some change, it's because  there is one that is not doing enough. And we  
change for another one of all simple because the  one that is playing is tired or is not pressing  
good. And today I think the the 11 that they were  in the pitch, they were all good. Pedro was very  
good. Jaden was very good. Niko was good. Cole was  good. Enzo was good. Moy was good. Josh was good.  
I mean make change for change. I don't like. I  like to make change when there is any reason why.  
And the reason why we changed Niko is because  he was pressing, was a bit tired, 10 minutes,  
15 minutes to go. markets fresh, new energy and  exactly the same with Nonny with Jadon. So this  
is the reason why. Nissan? Can you tell me about  your decision to pick Josh actually from his first  
Premier League start? How outraged was that  decision? How well did you do? For me it was,  
all the players for me, they were good today. If  I have to decide for one, I think for sure Josh  
was our best player because of the age, because it  was the first game and the reason why is because I  
already said with you many times that Josh, for  me, can be a top player for this club, but he  
needs the right path, the right moment. With young  players you have to decide in which moment. And we  
decided today because we saw that he's ready.  Today I think he showed how good he is. Now,  
again, because of the age, he has to slow down,  work hard and take the next chance. I'm sure  
you trust him though, because some people could  say, Mere you should sign a sense about you have  
two injures now. But it shows maybe interest job  to be one percent of that. Yeah, even if we don't  
decide to buy player or sell players because  we win or we lose game or because Josh showed  
that we knew already that Josh is good enough.  But probably with the West and Benoit injury,  
we see if something is going to happen. Liam.  Fatigue can often be an issue at this time of  
year. Tightness will match yourself back together.  You've put in a third round now. Is there an  
opportunity for a refresh? Yeah, Yeah for sure,  for sure. Now, fortunately, they just said to me  
now that after September is the first week that  we have entire week now, so we have a chance to  
to work this week and then prepare the FA Cup  game and then again with the Premier League.  
Yeah, but it's going to be like this until  the end. We can be fifth, or we can be sixth  
in the table. We can be third, second again,  hopefully. But at the end, I think it's going  
to be until the last two, three games. And then  when we are right there, we we see. Malek. Just  
on what you're saying about needing to be more  clinical, you said something similar, part of the  
Everton game being the past game at home. What  do you do to improve that? Is that a mentality  
thing? No, No first of all, I always said that the  important thing is to create chances. Because if  
you create chances, it means that you are doing  the right things. And then you have to take the  
chances. I think if you think about Ipswich game,  we are again so many chances there. Sometimes  
it's football, sometimes you create And you score.  Sometimes you create one chance and you score one.  
And sometimes you need to create 10 to score two.  In this moment, it's like this. What we can do?  
Try to be even more intense during the week when  we prepare the game, even if the the intensity  
or the intention of the players is is top. But  for sure, it's something that probably we need  
to we need to improve, thinking that we are we are  one of the two or three best team in score goals  
in this moment. How close was Romeo Olaga to being  ready today? Romeo, hopefully, yeah, hopefully the  
next game he can be already involved. Two more,  Kieran and Ian. Nicholas Jackson, he tends to  
wear his heartless sleeve. He doesn't mind showing  when he's frustrated with himself. But how do you  
actually pick him up? Because I think he got one  goal in six games and obviously he. . . Yeah, but  
for for striker, sometimes all the chances they  have, they score. Sometimes they they have chances  
and they don't score. The important thing is  that Nico today, once again, I think as you said,  
he had two, three clear chances. So that means  that he's there, he's ready, and hopefully next  
time he can be a bit more lucky. But overall,  I think Nico did a good game today. Finish
